what: SPEC 10.6 map-coverage closure. Identifiers are sha12 hashes, never raw clip ids.

independent_recount.method: cache manifest clip_sha12 vs a directory listing of the map root; no trainer involved

mechanism: refc_v3_train.py _map_item: a clip with no GT file emits map_label=False and an all-false map_seen, so map_soft_ce scores ZERO cells. The window is DRAWN and still trains the planner and 3-D box heads; only the map term abstains. Not 'skipped'.
